name: milestone-api
description:
Scope: every route handler under apps/web/src/app/api as of Nov 5 2026 (34 files). The agent, vault, dispute,
status, reconcile and demo routes added after 0.2.0 are described at path, method, parameter and status level;
their response bodies are named in the descriptions rather than fully modelled.

Routes under apps/web/src/app/api. Authentication is a role cookie, `milestone_actor`, set by the role switcher
in the UI. Values: usr_client, usr_freelancer, usr_partner. A missing or unknown cookie acts as the client.
This is a hackathon stand-in for real sign-in. The two webhook routes do not use the cookie; they verify a
signature instead.

Deliveries are created by the GitHub webhook (source github_pr), by /api/milestones/{id}/deliver (manual) or by
/api/milestones/{id}/upload (upload). Advances go through /api/advances/offer and /api/advances/accept. The
/api/dev/paypal/* routes exist only while PAYPAL_MODE=simulated and answer 404 otherwise (mode answers always).
Roles: usr_client, usr_freelancer and usr_partner act on the demo contracts; the freelancer and client checks
compare the cookie's user with the contract's parties.

Agents authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer msa_...` (a mandate token from POST /api/agents) on /api/mcp and on
/api/milestones/{id}/review. Mandate, saved-PayPal and operator routes refuse any request with an Authorization
header: those are for people. /api/demo/reset exists only with DEMO_MODE=1.
